Title: Azure Site Recovery now supports customer-managed keys

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports replication of Azure virtual machines that have managed disks encrypted with customer-managed keys. It also supports replication of on-premises virtual machines to managed disks encrypted with customer-managed keys in Azure.

View a list of supported regions.

Learn more about how to replicate Azure VMs with customer-managed key-enabled managed disks and on-premises VMs with PowerShell.
